content: TanStack Query v5: useMutation does NOT retry on error by default ('By default, TanStack Query will not retry a mutation on error, but it is possible with the retry option'). useQuery defaults to retry:3; this repo overrides to retry:1 in main.tsx. Consequence: a 401 surfaced to React Query is fatal for mutations, so the 401/refresh interception must live below React Query in the fetch wrapper.
